subject: Request: Permission to publish Solace Health testimonial and logo on webinar landing
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Permission to publish Solace Health testimonial and logo on webinar landing

Hi Jillian —

Thanks again for taking part in our product webinar last week. We had a great turnout and several attendees specifically asked for more detail about how Solace Health integrated Redwood Inference for real-time summarization. With your permission, we'd like to: 

- Publish a short customer testimonial (1–2 sentences) attributed to you on the webinar landing page and in the follow-up email.
- Use Solace Health's primary logo (horizontal) on the webinar landing and on the case study page we're preparing.

I've attached a one-paragraph draft testimonial and a quick landing mock so you can see placement. If there are any brand/usage constraints (color versions, exclusion from paid ads, required attribution language), please send them along. We'd appreciate approval by end-of-day Friday, Jul 23, so we can update the landing before the paid social push.

Attachments: solace_testimonial_draft_v1.docx, webinar-landing-mock.png, solace_logo_pack.zip

If this should go through Legal/Corp Communications first, happy to loop them in — I've copied Priyom and Laura.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Kate Nguyen <kate.nguyen@solacehealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to publish Solace Health testimonial and logo on webinar landing

Connor / Jillian —

Legal has reviewed the draft and the proposed landing. We can approve publication subject to the following conditions: 

1) Testimonial language: Please remove any references to Solace's internal platform names; keep it generic (e.g., "our clinical data platform"). I've attached a redlined copy (solace_testimonial_redline.pdf) with the preferred wording.

2) Logo usage: Solace grants permission to use the provided primary horizontal logo for organic marketing and owned landing pages. Use in paid advertising or co-branded paid media requires separate approval. Please use the supplied color and reversed versions only; do not alter the logotype.

3) Attribution clause: Include the line: "Solace Health is a customer of Redwood Inference. Solace Health retains all rights to its trademarks." on the case study page footer.

4) Release: We will provide a signed release (permanent, non-exclusive) limited to the uses above; we are not granting permission for sublicensing. I'm attaching the signed PDF (solace_signed_release.pdf).

Once you update the testimonial and add the footer attribution, we'll confirm final approval.

Regards,
Kate Nguyen
Senior Counsel | Solace Health
kate.nguyen@solacehealth.com

Attachment: solace_signed_release.pdf, solace_testimonial_redline.pdf
